System

Four classes, talents, prerequisites and respec

Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist and Warden share a common body but differ through authored abilities, stat growth and talent graphs. The backend validates points, prerequisites/exclusivity and respec atomically; UI lines on a tree are not rules.

Scope and player interaction

Vanguard, Ranger, Arcanist and Warden share a common body but differ through authored abilities, stat growth and talent graphs. The backend validates points, prerequisites/exclusivity and respec atomically; UI lines on a tree are not rules.

StageMeaning
First integration: Phase16committed; full feature contract may include explicitly staged later extensions
EvidenceAuthored implementation specification; no native/Blueprint/backend runtime verified

UI state machine

Viewing → EligibleNode → SpendPending → Unlocked → ExclusiveConflict → RespecQuote → RespecPending

WBP_Skills observes results from URPGSkillComponent. Pending is not Accepted. Close/cancel clears local focus and stale callbacks, but cannot undo an already committed backend command.

Definitions, fields and units

Canonical definition: DA_SkillTree_Vanguard. Stable IDs, quantities, seconds and centimeters are validated by the owner, not inferred from translated labels or sprites.

Field / rule
ClassId: stable class.* ID; common BodyId
SkillTreeId/Version and NodeId: stable graph identities
PrerequisiteNodeIds, MinimumLevel, PointCost and MaxRank: bounded authored constraints
ExclusiveGroupId: mutually exclusive branches where designed
UnlockedAbilityIds/PassiveEffectIds: resolved from purchased node/rank
SpentPoints and EarnedPoints: validated totals, never negative
RespecQuoteId/Cost and BuildRevision: server-calculated

C++ / Blueprint / backend ownership

LayerResponsibility
URPGSkillComponentImplement the native validated request/state lifecycle described below; native runtime state is not editable by UMG.
Blueprint/Data AssetsTune the declared defaults and visual/asset assignments. Keep definition references EditDefaultsOnly/BlueprintReadOnly; cosmetic hooks cannot grant rewards.
Zone serverValidate live actor ownership, range/LOS, alive/action state, cooldown/tool/target rules and current session epoch where relevant.
BackendFor durable changes, revalidate trusted catalog/revision/ownership and commit records/source claims/receipt atomically. Read-only/cosmetic features have no durable mutation.
WBP_SkillsLocal observer/requester. Create only for local player; bind once, refresh immediately, unbind on teardown.

Custom command contracts

These names are project custom APIs or backend proposals, not existing Unreal/PaperZD nodes. Economic/backend requests are asynchronous; Pending resolves through the same command ID. Pure local queries are synchronous unless noted.

Command / result
RequestSpendSkillPoint(CommandId, NodeId, Rank, ExpectedBuildRevision) -> Purchased|PrerequisiteMissing|ExclusiveConflict|InsufficientPoints
GetRespecQuote(TrainerContext) -> Quote|NoService
ConfirmRespec(CommandId, QuoteId) -> ResetBuild|StaleQuote|InsufficientFunds
ValidateSkillGraph(TreeId) -> Valid|Cycle|MissingNode|UnreachableRequiredProgress

End-to-end command and observation flow

  1. Player opens WBP_Skills and sees eligible nodes computed from the current versioned build; locked nodes explain exact missing requirements.
  2. Spend request identifies node/rank only. Server/backend checks class, level, points, prerequisites, exclusive group and current build revision.
  3. Commit node ranks and point spend, increment build revision, and return the new durable build.
  4. Zone rebuilds GAS granted abilities/passives from the committed set, removing obsolete grants/effects without duplicating remaining ones.
  5. At trainer, respec quote specifies cost and scope; confirmation debits currency and resets the selected tree/ranks in one transaction. Restore required baseline abilities independent of optional talent choices.
  6. Reconnect/transfer reconstructs the same build from stable IDs; content migration validates removed/replaced nodes and refunds points under a recorded policy.

Editor configuration and real consumers

  1. Author four DA_Class_* growth/ability catalogs and four DA_SkillTree_* graphs. Start Vanguard/Ranger combat visuals in the slice when supported; Arcanist/Warden casting/healing visuals are explicit art tasks.
  2. Populate sources/class-catalog.json with six example abilities and a small three-branch talent plan per class; these are production templates, not a balanced 50-level tree.
  3. Build WBP_Skills with keyboard/controller node navigation, rank/cost/requirements, confirmation and respec preview. Use a list alternative for accessibility.
  4. Place NPC_TovinTrainer and assign trainer service plus class/profession offers. Reopen dialogue, wallet and GAS grant lifecycle for the respec result.
  5. Validate graph acyclicity, class membership, no required story gate tied to an irrevocable exclusive node, and all referenced ability/effect IDs.

Reopen Phase16 integration entries after creating the assets. Test fixture: L_Rillmere / NPC_TovinTrainer / TalentFixture_A. No later-phase runtime dependency should be activated before its recorded integration phase.

Failure, contention and recovery acceptance

Test stimulus and expected result
Spend same points concurrently -> one valid commit; other StaleRevision/InsufficientPoints.
Skip prerequisite via forged request -> PrerequisiteMissing.
Buy both exclusive branches -> ExclusiveConflict.
Disconnect after respec charge -> one reset/charge, correct build on reconnect.
Patch removes node -> migration/refund record, no silent loss or unplayable character.

Repeat the success route with two clients when networking exists, then disconnect immediately before/after a committed result. Query the same command and compare authoritative snapshot/receipt with UI. Restart the relevant zone, reject stale epochs, and rerun the previous phase route. Pure visual/input features instead verify cleanup and unchanged server facts. These are future test recipes, not reported passes.

Tuning, accessibility and observability

Proposed one talent point per level after level 1, cap 50, starter respec cost 500 base currency. Costs/growth/branches are tuning proposals. No permanent class race/body art claim.

Audit build revision, node rank deltas, respec receipt and stat rebuild. Tooltips disclose active/passive effects and prerequisites without hidden UI-only conditions.

Art gaps, production and do-not-build-yet

The asset ZIP and installed PaperZD APIs remain unverified. Required new art/unsupported layer combinations are tracked in art/animation-matrix.html and art/equipment-visual-matrix.html. A legal debug visual can prove authority but is not finished content. Production features listed as later/optional remain disabled until their phase/gate passes.
